mask_roms.source: tools/fetch-rom-elfs.sh roms (espressif/esp-rom-elfs, pinned by SHA-256 in the script)

firmware.sketch: ble-scan-probe.ino (this directory); the C3 build's source has one more comment line at the top
firmware.build: arduino-cli 1.5.1, Arduino-ESP32 core 3.3.12 (ESP-IDF v5.5.5, from the images' esp_app_desc_t); the core's BLE library
firmware.not_committed: Plain Arduino builds of the sketch; not added to the repository.

runs.s3: esp32sim --rom roms/esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf --boot rom --board none --flash-mb 4 --bootloader bootloader.bin --ptable partitions.bin --app ble-scan.bin --elf ble-scan.elf --ble --ble-nearby name=Thermo,rssi=-70,addr=c4:aa:01:02:03:04,type=public,rsp=03030f18 --ble-nearby name=Scale,rssi=-82 --console uart0 --max-seconds 8 --no-dump
runs.c3: esp32sim --chip c3 --rom roms/esp32c3_rev3_rom.elf --boot rom --flash-mb 4 --bootloader c3-ble-scan.bootloader.bin --ptable c3-ble-scan.partitions.bin --app c3-ble-scan.bin --elf c3-ble-scan.elf --ble --ble-nearby name=Thermo,rssi=-70,addr=c4:aa:01:02:03:04,type=public,rsp=03030f18 --ble-nearby name=Scale,rssi=-82 --console uart0 --max-seconds 8 --no-dump
